question: What is the minimum age required to contest the Presidential election in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**35**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The minimum age required to contest the Presidential election in India is **35 years**.
 
• This eligibility criterion is specified in **Article 58(1)(b)** of the Indian Constitution.
 
• In addition to the age requirement, the candidate must be an Indian citizen and qualified to be elected as a member of the Lok Sabha.
 
• Presidential candidates must secure endorsements from at least 50 proposers and 50 seconders, who should be members of the Electoral College.
 
• The Electoral College for the Presidential election includes elected members of both Houses of Parliament and the Legislative Assemblies of States and Union territories.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Presidential Elections in India**

 
 
• The President is the head of state and the highest constitutional authority in India.
 
• The election process is conducted through a system of **proportional representation by means of a single transferable vote**.
 
• The President holds office for a term of 5 years but is eligible for re-election.
